newsitem.title: USA: AccelGraphics stock plunges after warning.
newsitem.headline: AccelGraphics stock plunges after warning.

text.p: Shares of AccelGraphics Inc dropped nearly 46 percent Thursday after the maker of three-dimensional graphics software said it expected its second-quarter earnings to fall short of Wall Street forecasts.
AccelGraphics dropped 4-1/16 to 5, with 1.9 million shares traded at midday, about 14 times its normal daily trading volume.

After the market closed on Wednesday, AccelGraphics said it expected earnings per share for the second quarter ending June 30 to be between $0.04 and $0.05, below the First Call consensus forecast of $0.12 a share.

"We continue to believe our fundamental strategy is on target ...," the company said in a prepared statement. "We believe we are continuing to broaden our customer base and strengthen our competitive position by developing and offering an expanding portfolio of leading-edge products."

AccelGraphics said it was on schedule to introduce lower-end OEM products and additional high-end products later this year. The company is also focusing its efforts to increase business in Europe and Japan.
AccelGraphics made its initial public offering on April 11, selling 2.6 million shares at $9 each.

The company said second-quarter results would fall short of earlier estimates because of sales softness in markets outside of the United States, pricing pressure and fewer-than-expected orders from a major original equipment manufacturer (OEM).

San Jose, California-based AccelGraphics said preliminary results showed revenues for the second quarter ranging from $9.75 million to $10.5 million compared with $3.1 million in the year-ago second quarter.
